ciliogenesis in vitro is a valuable tool for the diagnosis of ciliary dyskineis.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the absence of ultrastructural abnormalities of the cilia after culture of the cells is a major advantage of the sequential monolayersuspension culture system for the diagnosis of primary ciliary dykinesia (PCD).
ciliogenesis can be used to exclude SCD, which is a very important step in the diagnostic work-up of PCD.
the absence of SCD abnormalities in the culture system is a very strong indication of the absence of primary ciliary abnormalities in the biopsy.
